reserveReview.rationale: Re-verified against the live Frax frxUSD balance-sheet API on 2026-08-08. This review mirrors the live frax-balance-sheet adapter's exact normalized names and one-decimal weights and classifies every displayed slice, including the 1.7% EREBOR_USD unmapped token held as an exogenous unknown-asset slice rather than a tracked stablecoin dependency.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Official Frax frxUSD balance-sheet asset values normalized by the live frax-balance-sheet adapter
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unclassified reserve exposure remains in the official balance sheet or the live adapter output; the EREBOR_USD slice is explicitly named and classified as an unmapped exogenous asset.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: wtgxx-wisdomtree is a quarantined no-supply record (permitted runtime sources report no positive circulating supply or market cap) that can never carry a live score, so this slice is scored on its own fund-share asset class rather than linked as a dependency edge.
USDB is identified by the official balance sheet but remains outside the active scoring set, so it is not promoted into the active dependency graph.
EREBOR_USD is not listed in the live adapter's token display table and is not a tracked stablecoin dependency; it is classified as an unmapped exogenous reserve asset.
